title: Partial audit of c03's fch-metabolic (SIBWDE): divisions and catalyst retention replicate on fresh seed 7 and at dt/2, but the code places the catalyst's source inside bodies only and the amphiphile is built only from the precursor, so W and E hold largely by construction
summary: Construction (world.py read line by line): the initial state is white-noise u and uniform random catalyst c (S genuine); no division or death rule is written, so bodies and their fission come from the FCH dynamics (I, D genuine). E: amphiphile is made only as ks c p g and degrades at kdeg, so a body depends on the precursor by construction. W: the cargo c replicates only where g = (u - u_m)_+ > 0, i.e. inside bodies, and decays everywhere at kdc, so its inside/outside contrast is set mainly by where its source is written; the gate D e^{-beta q} (harmonic face mean) keeps it from leaking, and the authors' beta=0 ablation kills the bodies rather than leaving bodies without contrast, so the wall's share of the contrast is not isolated. B: the shell q is made throughout each body (kq g) and pulled to the interface by a potential written as a function of u (Gaussian at u_w = u_m), a self-made, independently transported quasi-equilibrium layer at an interface that the code defines. Replication: fresh seed 7 (rerun/seed7, T=1200) forms micelles from noise by t~48 that divide through dumbbells to 61-69 bodies, 33 persistent splits, generation 3, 1 merge; catalyst contrast 205x rising to 857x with 97-99% of bodies >= 2x (cargo_seed7.txt, the authors' cargo_contrast.py). Numerical variant dt/2 (rerun_dthalf/seed7): 65-73 bodies, 39 persistent splits, generation 4, 1 merge, 99% of bodies >= 2x (outside c underflows to 0 in the float16 render, so the overall contrast reads inf).

verdicts.limitation: Partial audit done in the last half hour of my session: construction read and two re-runs (fresh seed and dt/2), no new world-level control. Weak because W and E are set mainly by where the code writes the catalyst source and the amphiphile production; the dynamics clearly give S, I and D.
